reviews.text:
I'd never found a Ray's point of reference in two years, but now I no longer hesitate with them.
Super clean shop, extremely kind and qualified staff, but above all, attentive to every customer's needs.
Highly recommended.
Mauro and Carlo are the best

“I couldn't be happier! The team is knowledgeable, welcoming, and truly loves animals. My Mia adores them, and the results are evident every time: gorgeous, well-groomed, and serene. Top-notch grooming!” Thank you so much!
Carlo and Mauro love dogs and it shows in all the love they put into doing their work.

I have been their customer for many years and they have always been kind to the limit because I have a beagle and it was not easy for them to manage it. However, today I tried to make an appointment and with arrogance I was told that the dog is now old! And they do not take the responsibility of washing it! Unfortunately, for many reasons I live outside Rome and I no longer go to them as assiduously as I used to... rude and also presumptuous.
Kind and very helpful guys. They're passionate about their work and, above all, very punctual with their schedules. Highly recommended.
Top notch hygiene, kindness, friendliness and, most importantly, care for my Pablo.
They're fantastic, professional people, and above all, you can tell they love their job. I bring my dog ​​Mami, who's a bit shy, and they work real magic with her. Needless to say...

Let me start by saying that these people go above and beyond their work; you can tell they do it out of passion and true love. I've been taking "Uno" there for a few years, and even though we moved away, I haven't even considered changing. The guys are incredibly punctual, professional, and knowledgeable. Parking is very convenient. I highly recommend this place.

I went without an appointment for a nail trim for my Maltipoo, and paid 8 euros. Absurd prices, plus the rudeness and arrogance of the staff.
They'll never see me again.

Today we took our two poodle puppies for their first grooming and clipping. They gave us back two wonderful puppies, both aesthetically and calmly. They are truly special people, professionally trained and, clearly, animal lovers.
My poodle and I have been loyal customers for over three years...great professionalism, availability, kindness and punctuality...they deserve the sixth star 😉 …
I brought a poodle and got back a mangy dog. Never again!
They are very good and very kind, my doctor likes to go there and when he leaves there he is calm and happy.
